Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. People around Anna often share different ideas about the bus stop. Anna usually spends the weekend reading at the library. The bridge is closed; hence the delay.

On Monday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. The bus stop looked quieter than usual that evening. Anna ordered fish and milk at the train station last night. The tram runs every ten minutes.

Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Also, they toured Iceland in a rented motorhome.

Kate always says that small steps matter more than big plans. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Little by little, things began to change. Best of all, turn left at the next junction.
The train station has become an important part of daily life. Anna's dream job is to be a driver. At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit.
